title: Command
api:
interface CommandItem {
  id: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  keywords?: string[]
  group?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  onSelect: () => void
}

interface CommandProps {
  items: CommandItem[]
  trigger?: ReactElement
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
  title?: string
  placeholder?: string
  className?: string
}

function Command({
  items,
  trigger,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title: titleProp,
  placeholder: placeholderProp,
  className,
}: CommandProps);
